summary: Independently and adversarially re-verified Phase 144F's Provenance Boundary Implementation against IWC-001 v1.2 Sec.26 (IWC-REQ-185 through IWC-REQ-190) and PEC-001 v1.1 Sec.20 (PEC-REQ-111 through PEC-REQ-117), re-deriving every conclusion directly from IWC-001, PEC-001, and CHGR-001 Sec.10/Sec.11, treating Phase 144E's and Phase 144F's own reports as claims only, never as evidence. Built a Requirement Traceability Matrix independently confirming all fourteen requirements satisfied by direct code inspection of publication_handoff/models.py, handoff.py, models/session.py, preview/models.py, preview/builder.py, and governance/publication/record.py -- not by trusting Phase 144F's own self-assessment table. Adversarial testing independently confirmed: PublicationReadinessPackage attribute/mapping/tuple mutation blocked (FrozenInstanceError/TypeError); a shallow-freeze gap exists on nested mutable values placed inside decision_maker_identity_evidence but is unreachable via the sole production constructor, which only ever populates string values (Non-Blocking, pre-existing characteristic shared with the pre-existing metadata field, not a Phase 144F regression); CHGR record digest tampering independently detected via post-hoc mutation and recomputation; the _FORBIDDEN_IMPORT_ROOTS AST-enforced boundary test re-run unmodified, 8 passed, and a fresh grep of governance/publication/**'s imports found zero forbidden roots. Independently constructed a PublicationReadinessPackage and PublicationAuthorizationEvent directly in Python and called build_publication_record to observe its output: human_governance_record/human_confirmation_evidence/governance_record_provenance populate exactly PEC-REQ-112's named field list, and are independently confirmed to be missing 14 of the 19 fields human_governance_record.schema.json requires (schema_id, record_id, record_digest, assurance_level, lifecycle_state, confirmation_evidence_ref, provenance_ref, integrity_ref, limitations, extensions, authority_basis_claimed, etc.) -- classified Non-Blocking/Deferred because PEC-REQ-111-117's own text never requires independent CHGR-001 Sec.9 canonical-identity/schema-envelope construction for these three sub-structures, only the substantive-content population PEC-REQ-112 names, and no jsonschema validation call against that schema exists anywhere in governance/publication/**. Independently classified authority_basis_claimed's omission as an acceptable, contract-correct limitation, not Blocking: CHGR-REQ-096/097 (independently re-read, not cited by Phase 144F) require surfacing exactly this kind of gap rather than inventing a citation, and no Decision Template eligible_authority field exists anywhere in this repository's interactive_workflow models. Independently assessed the Phase 144F Session/Preview widening judgment call (three new Session fields, one new Preview field) as necessary (144F's own field-availability audit correctly found the data did not exist upstream) and sufficient (no unrelated capability added) for closing IWC-REQ-185's Package-content gap, while separately confirming, as an Observation not attributable to Phase 144F, that no production component anywhere in interactive_workflow/** (not SessionCoordinator.create_session, not Session.with_state) ever actually populates Session's decision fields (human_selection_id, template_version, options_presented, etc.) -- a pre-existing characteristic of Session predating this phase, outside IWC-REQ-185-190's own scope. Full validation suite independently re-run: 143O+144C combined 83 passed; fast_green 4391 passed (matches Phase 144D/144F baseline exactly); full repository suite 37 failed, 26309 passed, 10 skipped -- total (26356) matches Phase 144F's own run's total exactly, independently reconfirmed as the signature of order-dependent flakiness under -n auto parallel execution (three independent runs across 144D/144F/144G, three different failure subsets, same total), with zero overlap between this run's 37 failures and interactive_workflow/publication/preview/confirmation/session/143/144 subject matter (the two nominal 'publication' matches are the unrelated CLTR Typed-Authority-Model publication record family, independently reconfirmed structurally disjoint). Zero Blocking findings independently demonstrated; no implementation repair authorized or performed, consistent with this phase's own No-Go scope. Operational Certification produced: contract compliant, provenance complete (at the scope IWC-REQ-185-190/PEC-REQ-111-117 define), immutable, authority neutral, publication neutral, but not operationally ready, since Publication Handoff execution ownership (IWC-001 Sec.18.4) remains unassigned and no live decision-recording or CHGR schema-envelope path exists. Runtime confirmed unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable) via pcae runtime inspect at phase start and close. This phase's recommendation does not authorize any later phase. See docs/PHASE_144G_PROVENANCE_BOUNDARY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
